decision.question: Are both giraffes' markings and substantial interior modeling rendered through chalk drawing?
decision.criteria: Pass if both giraffes' spot patterns and substantial interior shading are visibly re-expressed through chalk marks, layered strokes or form-describing rubbed shading. Inspect each giraffe separately. Detailed spots, dark shading, accurate anatomy and smooth blending are permitted when the visible rendering supports chalk construction. Fail if substantial interiors of either giraffe still depend on photographic surface detail or photographic modeling with only added grain, smearing or drawn outlines. Chalk contours alone do not satisfy this condition. Return unknown only if visual evidence is unavailable or genuinely insufficient; transport or schema failures are not visual failures.
